caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is clear and transparent, with subtle gray and white highlights indicating its glass material and reflective surface. It has a bulbous lower body that tapers toward the neck, and a small, outward-curving spout at the top. The handle, attached to the upper body and curving downward, shows gentle detailing with a slight ridge. The pitcher rests on a short, circular pedestal base. The lines and shading are rendered delicately, primarily in tones of gray, white, and a hint of blue, which accentuate the transparency and reflective quality of the glass. The signature "J. M. Troy" is visible to the lower right of the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
